main_body: A dead/gothic weeping-willow style tree: a drooping dark brown canopy of hanging branches over a short flared trunk
top_band: none - the column scan shows only alternating dark/brown runs of the hanging branches; no lighter horizontal top surface
evidence: Organic tree with drooping branches. The scan shows only dark and mid brown runs, with no light top band, so it is a front-facing silhouette with no clear horizontal surface. The reference trees show a rounded canopy mass that reads as a volume from above, whereas this canopy is drawn as hanging strands. Because the kind is organic, the strict top band and front face contract does not map cleanly. The canopy has no lit top surface and reads as a flat front view, so it fails strictly.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 7 distinct colours and a median of 5 colours per tile, against about 108 per tile and 427-567 colours in the references. All its dark edge pixels are neutral (100%), so the outline is near-black, not a tinted material tone. Its ramp is about 3 browns (very dark, dark brown, mid brown) with sparse lighter dots, and the canopy has no leaf clumps or multi-tone shading. Beside the lush multi-green references it looks much thinner and more sticker-like.
